svg.text: Script detector — counts the characters, before the model sees them
a reply comes back in the script the farmer wrote in
routes, translates and explains — it does not do the agronomy
an exhausted daily quota never stops a farmer
what is spent is remembered, and survives a restart
no fertiliser dose without a lab test · no price forecast
an uncalibrated crop is named as uncalibrated, not guessed
Gurmukhi in, Gurmukhi out — decided in code
every figure names its model and inputs
read aloud in 24 languages, stoppable mid-sentence
6 · VALIDATED AGRONOMY — NOT THE LANGUAGE MODEL
7 · LIVE DATA AND PUBLISHED GUIDANCE — NOTHING MOCKED
8 · BRICS FEDERATION — COOPERATION WITHOUT SURRENDERING DATA
Federated averaging — weights travel, farm records never do
Each country trains on its own data and publishes model weights only.
A test asserts no node endpoint will return a record. It is the claim, enforced.
